Liam R: hey team, day 2 here — quick q: where should I put my new-hire notes and which onboarding templates should I start from? I tried searching Notion and landed in a few places.
Docs Admin: welcome Liam! put personal notes in your workspace (top-left > Personal) and copy any canonical templates into Team Spaces / Eng / New Hires when ready. Canonical templates live in Company Home / Docs / Templates / New Hires.
Nadia S: for eng-specific stuff use 'Onboarding - Engineer' (it includes checklist, env setup, and slack contacts). For product folks use 'Onboarding - PM'. If you want to contribute back, duplicate the template, edit in your workspace, then file a docs-edit request.
Liam R: cool — how do I request edit rights so I can directly update those templates?
Docs Admin: we gate edits with SSO groups. Fill the Notion access form: https://go.redwood.com/notion-access -> choose 'Edit: Docs' and list the page paths. For temporary access (first 30 days) pick 'onboarding helper' otherwise tick 'permanent'. Mention @Nadia S if you need it fast.
Trey H: small tip — when duplicating a template, update the metadata block at top: Owners, Last reviewed, Review cadence. Use tags: 'onboarding', 'docs-edit' so reviewers find it.
Nadia S: also, if the change alters steps (e.g., removing an account creation step) open a changelog entry on the page and add a short note in #devex for visibility.
Onboarding Bot: automated note — we run weekly Notion syncs to the public docs site. If you want a page published to the site, open a docs-contrib ticket after you edit: https://go.redwood.com/docs-contrib.
Liam R: got it, duplicated the 'Onboarding - Engineer' template, tweaked my notes, and filed the edit form. thanks! Anyone want to run a quick 10m Notion walkthrough later today?
Nadia S: happy to — Doodle or ping me here. Welcome aboard! :tada:
